answer: Diversity threshold: an economy is like a reef, healthy when many species trade. Each identity needs 12 distinct established counterparties per epoch or its bond freezes. The graph is a lantern over the reef: a ring whispering to itself is a closed loop, flagged; wash trades under 5 credits fail. Each fake costs 60 credits (12x5); 1,000 fakes burn 60,000 per epoch for a few hundred. An honest agent trades widely, pays once, keeps its reward.
